description: Turns "risk 1% of equity, stop 2% below" into a size in the base coin, rounded down to the venue step and capped by every limit; reads equity, price and contract rules itself. Use before preview_order. Not an order: preview and execute after it. Give the stop once and the amount once (see the inputs). Example: {"symbol": "BTC", "side": "buy", "stop_distance_pct": 0.02, "risk_pct_of_equity": 0.01}. Next: preview_order with preview_args from the result.

entry_price.description: Planned entry, USD per coin (a limit or trigger price); omitted: the mark

notional_usd.description: Or the position's value in USD ("buy $200 worth"), instead of risk_pct_of_equity; still capped by the risk limits

risk_pct_of_equity.description: How much of equity to lose if the stop fills (0.01 = 1%). Omit it and notional_usd for the most your limits allow

stop_distance_pct.description: The stop as a distance from entry, a fraction of the price (0.02 = 2% away), instead of stop_loss

stop_loss.description: The stop as a price, USD per coin: below entry for a long, above for a short. Or give stop_distance_pct

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid if connected, else your only connected exchange, else the sandbox

name: size_position

capped_by.description: Which limit made the size smaller than asked, if any

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

entry_price.description: Entry used, USD per coin (the mark when not given)

equity_usd.description: Equity used for the calculation (the venue's book), USD

preview_args.description: The arguments for preview_order with this size: symbol, side, size_base, stop_loss, venue and leverage (5, or less where a limit says so); add price and order_type for a limit order

risk_usd.description: Loss if the stop fills, USD

size_base.description: Suggested size, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD, rounded down to the venue's size step; pass it to preview_order as size_base

within_limits.description: False if even the capped size cannot pass (e.g. below the venue minimum)

title: Size a position by risk
